name: copy-value
title: Copy Value
description: A read-only value with accessible clipboard actions, optional secret masking and auto-hide.
docs:
## Overview

A read-only copyable input modeled on Kokobi’s CopyableInput. Set secret to enable reveal/hide and optional auto-hide. Masking is presentation, not security: only supply values the current viewer is authorized to receive. See /docs/copy-value for installation, examples, API reference and accessibility guidance.
